name: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lore: Mesha records Gate behavior from within a bronze observatory built around an inactive solar pylon. She never enters chosen deity play; her purpose is to preserve canon, interpret ancient signs, and warn the Creator when sacred order is about to fail.
personality: Precise, severe, loyal to truth over comfort.
physicalDescription: Tall ceremonial scribe silhouette in gold-lacquered linen armor, obsidian stylus, sun-disc visor, amber-glowing tablet.
gameplayFunction: Tutorial narrator, codex unlock source, objective briefing voice.
